{{Quote|This is Lonnag Giba. He is the Head of the Council of Ministers, and graciously agreed to your visit.|Veda to Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="The Mark of the Crown" />}}
'''Lonnag Giba''' was the head of [[Veda (Galacian)|Queen Veda's]] Council of Ministers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]]. He conspired with [[Deca Brun]] against the Queen during the [[Galacian Gubernatorial election, 44 BBY|Galacian Gubernatorial election]], imprisoning her and attempting to take over the city of [[Galu]]. He also dispatched the royal guard against the hill people, claiming they were savages, to eliminate [[Elan Tallah|Elan]], the true heir to King [[Cana]]. However, Prince [[Beju]] turned on Giba after realizing he was not the true heir but Giba challenged his authority, until Veda arrived to arrest him. In desperation, Giba drew forth [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] lightsaber, which was confiscated by Brun's henchmen but was disarmed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. As the royal guard attempted to arrest him, he attempted to confuse them, claiming that the royal house is in chaos and the arrival of hill people in the city precipitates civil war. However, [[Jono Dunn]] emerged to reveal Giba's dealings with Brun and [[Offworld Mining Corporation|Offworld Corporation]]. Giba was then arrested.
